title: Indian railway Tatkal booking agency (licensed booking bot operator)
description:
This disclosure concerns a verified set of records from an operator in the railway ticket booking services sector in India. The material scheduled for publication comprises the booking database with four railway booking accounts and payment collection accounts, browser profiles with the live booking site sessions, and complete booking logs with seven passengers' personal records including names, ages, gender and berth and food preferences, three client mobile numbers, trains, routes and fares.
Deadline: 2026-11-26 12:42 UTC
